rules.statement: Where a purchase is made in the name of a stranger, a trust of the legal estate results in favour of the person out of whose pocket the money for the purchase has come.
rules.supporting_quote: It is well-established law in England that where a purchase is made in the name of a stranger, a trust of the legal estate results in favour of the person out of whose pocket the money for the purchase has come (see Lewin on Trusts, 11th ed., p. 178, and the numerous cases there ) cited).
